provenance.writtenFor: Bank-surface batch (2026-10-21): one-time passcodes, session identifiers in URLs, account/balance pairs, statement exports, card form and CVV handling, PINs, recovery answers, BIC pairs
provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence

purpose: A bank response carries the evidence DPK-DAST-519 declares: sWIFT/BIC code served with an account reference.

groundTruth.rationale: The synthetic response reproduces the exact evidence DPK-DAST-519 inspects for this banking failure mode, with the rest of the response left ordinary so the finding is attributable to this one property.

limitations: Observation mode: a synthetic response object, not a live bank site.
A positive case proves the rule fires on this evidence; it is not a claim that a live banking system behaves the same way, and no request was sent.
